45: 	@Override
46: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<StandardException> annotation, Annotation ast, EclipseNode annotationNode) {

52: 			return;
53: 		}

56: 		if (classDef.superclass == null) {
57: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException requires that you extend a Throwable type");
58: 			return;
59: 		}
60: 		
61: 		AccessLevel access = annotation.getInstance().access();
62: 		
63: 		generateNoArgsConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
64: 		generateMsgOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
65: 		generateCauseOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
66: 		generateFullConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
67: 	}
68: 	
69: 	private void generateNoArgsConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
70: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
71: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
72: 		
73: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
74: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new NullLiteral(pS, pE), new NullLiteral(pS, pE)};
75: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, false, source, explicitCall, null);
76: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
77: 	}
78: 	
79: 	private void generateMsgOnlyConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
80: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
81: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
82: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
83: 		
84: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
85: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(MESSAGE, p), new NullLiteral(pS, pE)};
86: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, false, source, explicitCall, null);
87: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
88: 	}

90: 	private void generateCauseOnlyConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
91: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;

93: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;

98: 		causeDotGetMessage.sourceStart = pS; causeDotGetMessage.sourceEnd = pE;

100: 		causeDotGetMessage.selector = GET_MESSAGE;
101: 		Expression messageExpr = new ConditionalExpression(causeNotNull, causeDotGetMessage, new NullLiteral(pS, pE));
102: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {messageExpr, new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p)};
103: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, true, source, explicitCall, null);
104: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
105: 	}

110: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;

113: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(MESSAGE, p)};

118: 		causeDotInitCause.selector = INIT_CAUSE;
